Title: Trump says Hamas agreed to next phase of Gaza peace deal, including disarmament
First Paragraph: The president says Hamas and his international "Board of Peace" have agreed on the next steps in a peace deal that includes Hamas' disarmament in the Gaza Strip.

Title: Trump says he may pull Blanche's nomination until 2 Senate critics leave office
First Paragraph: President Trump said Todd Blanche will remain acting attorney general as a holdup on his nomination continues.

Title: Iran conflict expands as Senate again rejects effort to limit Trump's war powers
First Paragraph: A vote in the Senate to limit President Trump's war powers has narrowly failed again. Three Republicans voted in favor it.

Title: Saudi, Israeli leaders try to shape Trump's decisions on Iran conflict
First Paragraph: As conflict potentially expands in the region, Trump met with the Saudi defense minister and with Benjamin Netanyahu. The Israeli prime minister counseled Trump on three options for the war.

Title: U.S. investigating if Iran was behind cyberattack on Minnesota water systems
First Paragraph: Malicious cyber activity affected technology at more than 30 community water systems across Minnesota this week, leading authorities to dig into whether Iranian actors are behind the attack, CBS News has learned.

Title: Pentagon weighs eliminating civilian tenure at military academies, draft memo says
First Paragraph: The Pentagon is considering a sweeping remake of military higher education, including an end to civilian tenure and a "line-by-line" review of courses, according to a draft memo obtained by CBS News.

Title: Ukrainian ambassador tracks how Kyiv's relationship with D.C. has evolved,
First Paragraph: The outgoing Ukrainian ambassador to the U.S. says Ukraine has been able to combat what she said characterized as a prior, erroneous narrative that Russia was winning the war, now in its fifth year​.

Title: Father of Apalachee High School shooter sentenced to 15 years in prison
First Paragraph: Days after his son was sentenced, the father of the Apalachee High School shooter Colt Gray, is in court for his own sentencing hearing.

Title: Afghan woman to fight U.S. efforts to deport her over "alien terrorist" claim
First Paragraph: Nazira Haji Zada's lawyer argued that the Justice Dept. is violating her due process rights.
